executive_summary.text: Cost year 2025: direct care cost was $201.84 per resident day (40.3% of expenses); Connecticut median $174.45.

Cost year 2025: the home recorded $4,582,808 in Connecticut Medicaid revenue (after its Medicaid contractual allowance) for 12,317 Medicaid days, $372.07 per Medicaid day. DSS's Medicaid daily rate was $364.26 for July 2024 to June 2025 and $387.88 for July 2025 to June 2026.
Cost year 2025: nursing home operating margin was 3.4% (Connecticut median 2.5%).
Cost year 2025: nursing pool (agency) staff counted in direct care cost $1,667,001, 38.0% of the $4,387,703 direct care cost.

Cost year 2025: dietary cost $1,000,267, $46.01 per resident day (Connecticut median $29.51). Wages $521,917 (52.2%), allocated fringe $175,341 (17.5%), non-wage costs $303,009 (30.3%). Raw food was $262,290 ($12.07 per resident day; Connecticut median $8.61).
Cost year 2025: housekeeping cost $312,857, $14.39 per resident day (Connecticut median $12.32). Wages $211,702 (67.7%), allocated fringe $71,122 (22.7%), non-wage costs $30,033 (9.6%).
Missing data: cost years 2019, 2020, 2021 left out because the figures failed the site's checks (reasons under missing_data)

findings.statement: Cost year 2025: DSS's review changed 11 line(s) of the report, a net reduction of $32,903 in the costs DSS counts. Largest: Non Movable Equipment (page 22 line 7c), removed $14,776; Movable Equipment (page 22 line 7d), removed $11,440; Automobile Expense (page 16 line l6), removed $3,439. Separately, the home itself removed $1,096,425 from the costs it claimed (for example bad debt, pharmacy or therapy that the daily rate does not cover). The data shows each change, not the reason.

definitions.wages_reported: Salaries and wages printed on the cost report for that department. Not total department spending.
definitions.total_department_cost: Wages + allocated fringe + non-salary costs for the department, as computed by the site's cost-report build.
definitions.direct_care: DSS rate-setting definition: nursing and aide salaries, related fringe (allocated), and nursing pool (agency) cost.
definitions.figures: As filed by the home before DSS audit. Not Medicaid-allowable costs.
definitions.data_quality: Per year: status validated (core figures present, payer days add up, nothing out of range), unvalidated (read, but printed totals did not fully reconcile: treat as provisional) or check_failed (core figures missing or implausible: not used in reports). unusable_fields lists figures in that year that should not be quoted, with the reason.
definitions.raw_food_per_resident_day: Raw food cost / resident days. Only shown when the home buys its own food; when a contractor supplies meals the raw-food line is not comparable.
